dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgRemoveLiqu.title: Msg Remove Liquidity
dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgRemoveLiqu.description: * Remove liquidity (anyone). Behavior: - Burns shares and returns the underlying reserves. - Full exit: burn all outstanding shares to delete the pool and receive the   full reserves. - Partial exit:   - Concentrated pools: ΔL-based outputs within the current price band.   - Non-concentrated pools: pro-rata outputs using DecCoins. Safety and validation: - Pool must exist; signer must hold at least `shares`. - Outputs must be non-zero. - Partial exits cannot deplete any reserve; use full exit to withdraw the   last liquidity. - Concentrated pools: post-state price must remain within band; ΔL must   match burned share ratio within a small tolerance. Emits: EventPoolLiquidityRemoved on success.
